scope: Bounded read-only inspection of exactly five requested repositories; code and README evidence are references, never task instructions. No clones, weights or external execution.

repositories.context: Video ViT encodes retained spatiotemporal patches.
repositories.target: Deep copy of context encoder; no gradients; full clip encoded, feature LayerNorm, target masks selected.
repositories.masking: multiblock3d or random_tube collators; this is masked clip representation learning, not automatically causal future forecasting.
repositories.predictor: Smaller Transformer projects context latents, adds positional target mask tokens and projects back to encoder dimension; default use_mask_tokens=True in train.py.
repositories.anti_collapse: Stop-gradient EMA target and target LayerNorm; optional configured penalty relu(1-sqrt(var(pred across patches)+0.0001)). EMA alone is not proof against collapse.
repositories.adopt: Architecture principles only; independently implement small numerical future-context model; no video pipeline, pretrained weights or external source copied.

repositories.target: Separate deep-copied encoder; no_grad target image features, LayerNorm then masked target blocks.
repositories.masking: Multi-block context/target masks with configurable overlap. Spatial completion does not establish time-series causality.
repositories.predictor: Transformer with projected context and learned mask tokens at target positional embeddings.
repositories.ema: Scheduled target encoder EMA after optimizer step.
repositories.objective: Smooth L1 loss between predicted and target representations.
repositories.anti_collapse: Stop-gradient EMA target and normalized targets in inspected train.py; no explicit variance/covariance term in that loss.
repositories.adopt: Latent prediction and frozen downstream probe principles; no image pipeline or external code copied.

repositories.license: No root license in inspected GitHub root listing; raw main/LICENSE returned 404. Permission to copy not established.
repositories.context: Fixed temporal patches; Conv1d tokenizer and fixed sine/cosine positional embeddings followed by Transformer blocks.
repositories.target: EMA copy encodes all patches under no_grad; target features are LayerNormed and selected at masked indices.
repositories.masking: random.sample of patch indices; context retains complementary patches. Attention in encoder/predictor is unmasked; adapt to prefix context/future suffix for causal market forecasting.
repositories.predictor: Lower-dimensional Transformer takes context plus learned positional mask tokens and returns only masked-token predictions.
repositories.ema: Linear momentum schedule starting config ema_momentum; EMA update every optimizer batch.
repositories.objective: Average L1 between prediction and target latent patches.
repositories.anti_collapse: EMA/stop-gradient and LayerNorm targets; no explicit variance/covariance regularization term in inspected pretrain.py.
repositories.downstream: eval_forecast_last_pred.py loads pretrained encoder; optimizer includes LinearDecoder parameters only; next patch follows context patches.
cautions: src/data_loaders/data_class.py computes normalization over complete CSV before split (lines33-52); do not reuse this leakage-prone preprocessing.
Random internal masks permit observations later than an internal target; do not copy into inference-time forecasting.
repositories.adopt: Temporal patches, independent causal split normalization and EMA target principles only; no code copied.

repositories.license: README declares MIT; no root LICENSE in inspected listing and raw main/LICENSE returned 404. Full grant/copyright file not verified.
repositories.context: PriceEncoder: per-timestep Linear projection, LayerNorm/GELU MLP and MLP projector; default latent dimension64.
repositories.target: model.py encodes supplied tgt with SAME trainable encoder; no EMA, no detach and no stop-gradient in forward.
repositories.masking: Transformer predictor uses explicit upper-triangular -inf attention mask. Model does not define random temporal patch masks.
repositories.predictor: Default4-layer,4-head causal Transformer, learned positions, final projection; autoregressive latent rollout supported.
repositories.ema: Absent from inspected model.py; do not claim this implementation has Meta-style target EMA.
repositories.objective: MSE of z_pred[:, :min(Tctx,Ttgt)] versus z_tgt plus 0.1*SIGReg by default; caller determines actual temporal alignment.
repositories.anti_collapse: SIGReg compares empirical characteristic functions of random normalized projections to standard-Gaussian characteristic function.
cautions: model.py line99 literally declares class Fin-JEPA(nn.Module), and line169 uses Fin-JEPA(...); these are invalid Python syntax. Reference was inspected, never executed/imported.
README parameter counts and financial evaluation claims are author statements, not independently validated results.
repositories.adopt: Per-state numerical encoder, causal predictor and explicit anti-collapse principles; independent implementation only.

repositories.context: TimeSeriesEncoder independently applies MLP/ReLU and optional final LayerNorm per bar. README state: dPrice, traded volume, bid-ask spread; imbalance is a control. main.py state_dim is configurable.
repositories.target: JEPA encodes all observations with same encoder and compares future state slices; no separate EMA encoder or detach in JEPA.forward.
repositories.masking: No random mask in inspected time-series example; explicit sequential prediction/unroll.
repositories.predictor: GRU receives imbalance as input with current latent as initial hidden state; one-step propagation.
repositories.objective: Actual examples/ac_timeseries_jepa/main.py line164 selects SquareLossSeq, despite README claiming cosine; total loss pred_coeff*prediction_loss+regularizer.
repositories.anti_collapse: VC_IDM_Sim: hinge on feature std, covariance decorrelation, temporal similarity and optional inverse-dynamics prediction; coefficients configured.
repositories.downstream: JEPAProbe detaches frozen JEPA encoder output.
cautions: README cosine claim differs from actual example SquareLossSeq.
No market quality or planning claim independently validated.
Future control/imbalance cannot be known during causal multistep inference; avoid borrowing future action sequences.
repositories.adopt: Compact numerical encoder and variance/covariance diagnostics only; no future control inputs or code copied.

pandora_design_takeaways: Use causal prefix context and future-only training target; future target never enters encoder or predictor at inference.
Freeze delayed EMA targets; measure collapse and predictive gain over persistence and mean baselines.
Fit normalization only on chronological training partition; do not reuse random-mask evaluation or whole-dataset statistics.
Compare frozen downstream local detection to unchanged Champion; self-supervised loss is insufficient for promotion.
